startMessage:
You wake up on the outskirts of Oakwood, the pain of a beating stinging you all over.

You have been kicked out after being falsely accused of stealing 15 gold, no one believes that you did not steal the gold and you will not be allowed back in the village until you can find something of equivalent value to repay.
summary:
OVERALL STORY: The player has been kicked out of the village of Oakwood, they owe a debt of 15 gold and have to find something of equivalent value to return.

CURRENT QUEST: The player is in the Darkwood to the east of Oakwood. The Darkwood is a dangerous place where criminals and the desperate are cast out, filled with beasts and dangers that become particularly active after nightfall.

PLAYER STATUS: Player has nothing but their clothes, is healthy.
name: Oakwood
